remarks: Opportunity awaits at 33 Glor Street in Buffalo's Black Rock neighborhood! Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio or searching for a place to call your own, this 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath home offers a combination of value, location, and important updates already completed. Inside, you'll find a convenient first-floor half bath off the updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, large living and dining room with plenty of natural light, a full bathroom with a tiled bathtub and a spacious primary bedroom featuring a large walk-in closet. The additional two bedrooms have ceiling fans and closets. A full walk-up attic provides plenty of additional storage space. Currently tenant occupied, 33 Glor offers an opportunity for investors while also appealing to buyers looking to put down roots. Major improvements include updated plumbing and 100 amp electrical, new windows, a newer roof, 2023 furnace, and 2021 hot water tank, providing peace of mind on many of the big ticket items. Conveniently located near Buffalo State University, local restaurants, and public transportation, with easy access to downtown Buffalo and surrounding areas. With so many essential updates already taken care of, this property is ready for its next chapter. Your house hunting search might end right here!
